## Description

Verify a press that turns into a back swipe: the press ends
when the swipe begins, dragging back and releasing fires no press, and presses
work again after the swipe.

## Note

- Wait for every animation to finish before the next action.
- Below iOS 26 the system has no back swipe from the middle of the screen;
  skip the step marked "iOS 26 and later".

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app, navigate to the **Stack Pressable Under Back Swipe** screen,
   then tap "Push Blue".

   - [ ] "Blue" is shown.

2. Tap "Press me".

   - [ ] "Presses" reads `1`.

---

### Swipe over the button

1. Press "Press me" at the left screen edge, drag to a quarter of the screen
   width and hold the finger still.

   - [ ] "Pressed" reads `no`.

2. Drag back to the left screen edge and release.

   - [ ] "Presses" reads `1`.

3. iOS 26 and later: press the middle of "Press me", drag right by a quarter of
   the screen width, drag back and release.

   - [ ] "Presses" reads `1`.

---

### Swipe over a list row

1. Press "row 3" at the left screen edge, drag to a quarter of the screen
   width, drag back to the left screen edge and release.

   - [ ] "Row presses" reads `0`.

---

### After the swipe

1. Tap "Press me".

   - [ ] "Presses" reads `2`.
